definitions.gloss: full name, surname and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name including family name and personal name.

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in your full name.

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}{判断|はんだん}をしてもらった。
examples.english: I had my fortune told based on my name.
examples.notes: {姓名|せいめい}{判断|はんだん} = fortune telling by name

examples.japanese: {姓名|せいめい}の{読|よ}み{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me how to read your full name.

notes:
COMPONENTS:
・{姓|せい} - surname, family name
・{名|めい} - given name, first name

JAPANESE NAME ORDER:
In Japanese, the family name ({姓|せい}) comes first, followed by the given name ({名|めい}). This is the opposite of Western name order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{姓名|せいめい}を{書|か}く (to write one's full name)
・{姓名|せいめい}{判断|はんだん} (name-based fortune telling)
・{姓名|せいめい}の{記入|きにゅう} (entering full name on forms)

HOMOPHONES:
・{声明|せいめい} - statement, declaration
・{生命|せいめい} - life
